app.title: mccboard
language.label: Language
instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitle: Claude Code instances mccboard manages, grouped by account.
instances.empty: No instances found: no ~/.claude or ~/.claude-* folder in your home.
login.expired_hint: Claude Code renews it the next time it runs in this instance.
error.home_unreadable: mccboard can't read your home folder.
error.unknown: Something went wrong while talking to mccboard's core.
section.proposals_hint: Scanning only proposes folders: register the ones mccboard should manage.
registered.empty: No instance registered yet. Register one found below, or any folder by path.
action.unregister_hint: mccboard forgets this instance; its folder stays as it is.
register_path.label: Register a folder by path
account.field.label: Label
account.no_account_hint: Instances that weren't logged in when they were registered.
account.unknown_hint: This account isn't in config.toml. Register one of its instances again to add it.
status.changed: Now logged in as {account}, not with the account it was registered with ({registered}).
status.unrecorded: Logged in as {account} since it was registered.
notice.new_account: New account “{label}” added: you can change its label and color.
error.config_corrupt: config.toml isn't valid, so mccboard won't change it. Fix it by hand: this window updates as soon as you save it.
error.relative_path: Give a full path, or one starting with ~.
error.label_taken: Another account already has that label.
error.invalid_launcher: A launcher name uses letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', and can't be “claude”.
drift.problem.missing_link: {item} is missing: it should be a link to the primary instance's {item}.
drift.problem.unlinked_skill: The personal skill “{skill}” is in the primary instance but isn't linked here, so this account can't use it.
drift.problem.broken_link: {item} is a link to {target}, which doesn't exist.
drift.problem.broken_link_unreadable: {item} is a link that can't be read.
drift.problem.wrong_target: {item} is a link to {target}, not to the primary instance's {item}.
drift.problem.link_chain: {item} is a link to {target}, which is a link itself: more than one hop. Claude Code saves settings by following a single hop, so a chain can break.
drift.problem.not_a_link: {item} is a separate copy, not a link to the primary instance's {item}, so changes to one don't reach the other.
drift.problem.whole_folder_link.skills: skills is linked as a whole folder, so every account shares the same skills/synced folder, where Claude Code keeps each account's claude.ai skills.
drift.problem.whole_folder_link.plugins: plugins is linked as a whole folder, which breaks plugin marketplace validation in both instances.
drift.problem.duplicate_hooks: The primary instance's settings.json defines hooks. When Claude Code runs in this instance from your home folder, it also loads that file as project settings, so those hooks may run twice (anthropics/claude-code#80791).
drift.repair.replace_link: replace it with a single link to {target}.
drift.repair.backup_and_link: move this copy to a backup in ~/.mccboard/state/, then link {item} to {target}.
drift.repair.migrate_skills: make skills a real folder in this instance with one link per personal skill ({skills}), and keep this account's skills/synced private.
drift.repair.migrate_skills_none: make skills a real folder in this instance, and keep this account's skills/synced private.
drift.repair.migrate_plugins: give this instance its own plugins folder; its plugins are then reinstalled with Claude Code's own commands.
drift.repair.nothing: nothing to do, this is for your information.
sharing.title: Unknown items in the primary instance
sharing.hint: mccboard doesn't know these. Choose once whether every linked instance links each one from the primary instance or keeps it private; the answer is saved in config.toml.
notice.shared_link: {item} will be linked from the primary instance in every linked instance.
error.invalid_sharing_item: Only unknown items of the primary instance take an answer.
launcher.primary_hint: The primary instance keeps plain claude.
launchers.title: Launchers
launchers.not_on_path: This folder isn't on your user PATH, so terminals won't find the launchers.
launchers.orphan: {name} isn't needed by any registered instance any more.
launchers.none: No linked instance registered, so no launcher is needed.
notice.new_terminal: Open a new terminal to use them.
notice.path_added: Added {path} to your user PATH: open a new terminal to use the launchers.
notice.path_not_added: Couldn't add {path} to your user PATH: add it by hand.
error.launcher_unreadable: mccboard can't read the file or folder that holds the launchers.
error.launcher_unwritable: mccboard can't write the launchers. Any other change was saved.
error.launcher_block_corrupt: mccboard's block in your shell's rc file has lost its end marker. Fix or remove it by hand: mccboard won't rewrite it.
